author: liam.oconnor - Sports Editor
title: Mikus Losbergs: New Head Men's Tennis Coach
text:
Mikus Losbergs Named head Men’s Tennis Coach at Sacramento State Sacramento State University has appointed Mikus Losbergs as its new head men’s tennis coach, following the retirement of Kevin Kurtz after eight seasons. The announcement, made by Director of Athletics Mark Orr, marks a new chapter for the Hornet men’s tennis program.
Losbergs has been a continuous presence within the Sacramento State tennis community for the past decade, first as a player from 2015 to 2019 and then as an assistant coach from 2019 to 2025. This extensive familiarity with the program and its values was a key factor in his selection.
“We are thrilled to see Mikus take the next step in his journey with Sacramento State as the head men’s tennis coach,” Orr stated. “as a former standout player and dedicated assistant coach, Mikus embodies the values of our program – hard work, passion, and a commitment to excellence both on and off the court. His deep connection to the Hornet family makes him the ideal leader to guide our student-athletes and continue the proud tradition of Sacramento State men’s tennis.”
During his six-year tenure as assistant coach, Losbergs contributed to all facets of the program, from recruiting and on-court coaching to scheduling , travel logistics, and budget management. He played a pivotal role in the team’s success,notably in 2024,when the Hornets achieved a remarkable 17-7 overall record,a 7-1 conference mark,and secured both the Big Sky regular season and tournament championships,culminating in an NCAA Tournament appearance. That season also saw the team achieve a seven-match winning streak – the longest since 2010 – and an eight-match winning streak against Big Sky opponents, a feat unmatched since 2011. A program-record six Hornets earned all-Big Sky honors, including conference MVP Mark Keki.
Losbergs expressed his gratitude for the opportunity, stating, “First, I want to thank Mark Orr for giving me this astonishing opportunity. I’m truly honored,and it’s a great privilege to be part of a University with such a rich athletic history.I’m energized by the chance to lead a group of talented and dedicated student-athletes who are hungry to grow, compete, and succeed.”
He outlined his vision for the program, emphasizing a culture built on “hard work, accountability, and relentless pursuit of excellence.” Losbergs intends to focus on developing well-rounded individuals, stating, “We’ll focus on developing not only strong tennis players, but strong young men who represent Sac State with pride in everything they do.”
Prior to the 2024 success, Losbergs contributed to consistent advancement during his early years as an assistant, helping the Hornets finish 12-7 overall and 5-2 in the Big Sky Conference in 2023, achieving a 9-1 record at home.In 2020, Sacramento State’s recruiting class was ranked ninth nationally among mid-major institutions, a testament to Losbergs’ recruiting acumen.Keki, a standout recruit from that class, became the first Hornet in program history to earn first-team all-Big Sky honors in both singles and doubles play for all four years of his collegiate career.
losbergs’ own playing career at Sacramento State was distinguished, earning him all-Big Sky Conference selection four times (first team in 2017 and 2019, second team in 2016 and 2018). He was the first Hornet to achieve this four-time recognition since Kiryl Harbatsiuk from 2008-2011. He concluded his playing career with a 47-39 dual singles record and a 29-14 mark in Big Sky matches, consistently playing at the No. 1 singles position. In doubles play, he amassed a 49-33 dual record and a 28-12 league record, also primarily at the No. 1 spot,even reaching a national ranking of 30th with partner Kasparas Zemaitelis during the 2015-16 season.
Beyond his athletic achievements, Losbergs was a four-time Big Sky all-academic selection and a three-time ITA Scholar-Athlete, graduating from Sacramento state with a degree in communication studies in 2019.This commitment to academic excellence underscores his dedication to the holistic advancement of his student-athletes.
